newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet gains on IPE, barge premiums firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet gains on IPE, barge premiums firm.

text.p: European jet prices firmed in line with IPE futures on Thursday and premiums were notionally unchanged in desultory business, traders said.
Benchmark Nov IPE futures finished $1.50 firmer at $218.75 after shaving earlier gains as Brent futures were carried lower by U.S. NYMWEX gasoline losses.

Barge premiums were steady at Nov IPE +$34 fob ARA, bolstered by refiners' use of jet and heating to produce additional diesel. Cargoes for early November were Nov IPE+$32 cif NWE and in the south fob MED high +$5.
